name: BTOR2 models of the Hardware Model Checking Competition 2019 and 2020
organizers: the HWMCC organisers; this copy is the mirror kept by Kevin Laeufer
layout: btor2/<bv|array>/<year>/<submitter>/*.btor, the split single property models of the two editions
terms: the models of the competition, as mirrored; no licence file in the mirror
note: the competition distributed AIGER until 2017 and BTOR2 from 2019, which is why this collection exists beside hwmcc10: same competition, a format nine years later. The mirror says it holds the split, selected and bit-blasted single property benchmarks of HWMCC'20, with the 2019 models beside them. This repository keeps the manifest and the pinned commit, never the models: tools/fetch_upstream.py clones it into a local cache, and the CNF encodings are produced on demand by the BTOR2 bridge.
